title: Move for 60 minutes per day.
subtitle: Advanced daily activity
rationale: Use the day’s open edges for movement until a genuinely active day is the baseline.
tierTarget: 60 minutes of movement on most days

evidence.summary: Higher volumes of regular physical activity are associated with broader cardiovascular and long-term health benefits.

indications: 45 minutes of daily movement is already consistent.
Long sedentary stretches remain despite a movement habit.
An active day needs to become the default, not the exception.
